summary: A dedicated two-player Unmatched box pitting Robin Hood's ranged, resource-stealing outlaws against Bigfoot and his Jackalope companion smashing through terrain. It delivers the same fast, dice-free tactical duel as other Unmatched sets, just packaged as a standalone two-hero matchup that can also be folded into larger four-player games with other sets.
praised: strong thematic contrast between a ranged skirmisher and a brawler
cheaper, focused entry point into the Unmatched system
quick to teach and quick to play
combines cleanly with other Unmatched boxes
criticised: only two heroes limits variety on its own
less value if you don't plan to mix with other sets
Bigfoot's terrain-smashing can feel swingy against inexperienced Robin Hood players

interaction.kind: direct one-on-one combat with hand-based bluffing
interaction.detail: The two heroes fight directly on a shared point-to-point map, attacking and defending with cards from hand, so essentially the entire game state is contested rather than private.

scoring.how_you_win: You win by reducing all of an opponent's characters' health to zero through card-driven attacks, defeating their side entirely; there is no point total.

similar: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One
